On December 20, we started a regular Azure API Management service update. It includes the following bug fixes, changes, and new features:

  • Improved validation of back-end URLs. We now enforce valid back-end URLs in API configuration and set-backend policy. 
  • Renamed SSL blade. The previous SSL blade has been renamed to Protocol settings.  
  • HTTP/2 support on the client side. We now support HTTP/2 between clients and the API Management gateway. It can be enabled in Protocol settings. 

Note that updates are deployed gradually in batches, and it usually takes a week or more for every active service instance to receive them.
